research_question: What do Amazon's earnings releases show about sales, segments, cash flow, and spending?

research_brief.purpose: Report Amazon's results by segment with cash flow and capital spending.
research_brief.audience: Readers, sellers, and investors looking for sourced Amazon figures.
research_brief.data_period: Fiscal 2025 and the first half of 2026. Updated with 2026 results to date and published projections as of October 4, 2026.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Company-reported figures. Second quarter 2026 net income includes large non-operating gains. No view on the stock.

statistics.claim: Amazon net sales were $716.9 billion in 2025, up 12%; operating income was $80.0 billion (2024: $68.6 billion); net income was $77.7 billion.
statistics.limitations: As reported; later filings may restate

statistics.claim: In 2025 AWS sales were $128.7 billion (up 20%) with operating income of $45.6 billion; North America sales were $426.3 billion with operating income of $29.6 billion; International sales were $161.9 billion with operating income of $4.7 billion.
statistics.limitations: As reported; later filings may restate

statistics.claim: Amazon free cash flow was $11.2 billion for 2025, down from $38.2 billion for 2024; purchases of property and equipment were $128.3 billion.
In Q2 2026 Amazon net sales were $200.6 billion, up 20%; AWS sales were $42.2 billion, up 37%, its fastest growth in 18 quarters; operating income was $27.5 billion (Q2 2025: $19.2 billion).
statistics.limitations: As reported; later filings may restate

statistics.claim: Amazon guided third quarter 2026 net sales of $197.0 billion to $202.0 billion, growth of 9% to 12%, and operating income of $22.5 billion to $26.5 billion against $17.4 billion in the third quarter of 2025.
statistics.limitations: Company guidance; a forecast that can change

statistics.claim: For the twelve months to June 2026 Amazon reported operating cash flow of $161.4 billion, purchases of property and equipment, net, of $169.0 billion, and negative free cash flow of $7.6 billion; AWS operating income was $16.6 billion in the second quarter of 2026.

Segment operating income is rarely shown.
Free cash flow and capital spending are almost absent.

verification_log.summary: Keyword data from Ubersuggest (United States), five ranking pages reviewed. Annual, segment, and second quarter 2026 figures checked against the releases. The first quarter 2026 release and SEC filings page load. Body claims checked: 2024 net sales, segment sales and operating income, operating cash flow of $139.5 billion, the $50.7 billion rise in property and equipment purchases, and second quarter 2026 segment growth. The post quotes no first quarter 2026 figures and gives no figures for advertising, subscriptions, or sellers. 2026 update of 2026-10-04: Added trailing twelve month cash flow to June 2026, second quarter AWS operating income, and Amazon's third quarter 2026 guidance.
